Prospecting is a job where you try your luck at metal detecting. See what treasures lay below! Prospecting will give you both Strength and Mining XP and you may also dig up items that increase your luck at Fishing.

Getting Started

  1. First you will first need to get hold of a Prospecting Scanner, You can obtain one of these at the Market(Fishing/Diving) for the cost of 10 skill tokens.
  2. Head over to the current prospecting area indicated on the map by
  3. Press E to start prospecting.
  4. Roam the 200m prospecting circle hunting for treasure. Prospecting works like a game of hot and cold, when you get close to something beneath the ground a green circle will appear, it will transition from Green to Yellow to Red and the beeping frequency will increase as you get closer.
  5. When you have located the treasure you will be prompted to dig, hit left click to do so.
  6. Once dug up you will be rewarded with your treasure along with Strength and Mining XP.
    Keep in mind that digging up the same spot that's already being dug by another player will only reward the first person to dig.
  7. Repeat

Note:The prospecting area is selected at random and will only change each time the server is restarted.

pages.h:
As a quarry worker you can work together with other players to earn Mining and Trucking experience.

Getting Started

Head over to the Quarry in Sandy Shores and go to the Specialized Job Center ( ) and select the Quarry Worker job. Then, head over to the spawners besides the job center to spawn an excavator or dump truck.

Doing the Job

The Quarry worker job is co-op friendly, where players can choose to use the dump truck () while at Mining level 1-50. once you reach level 50 you can use the Excavator (). Additionally, when you reach Mining level 70 you gain access to a special dump truck, which you can spawn near the drop-off point for the dump trucks () The Excavator operator's job is to dig up buckets of gravel and dump it into the dump truck(s) till it's full. The dump trucks then take it to a drop-off point marked on their map (Randomly chosen point) and tip it away to receive rewards. (Mining and Trucking XP Split between the number of helpers)

In order to take the role of a truck driver, you need to spawn the dump truck at the spawner next to the Specialized Job Center ( ). When you have spawned the truck, go over to one of the excavators and park the truck up next to them, so they can dump their bucket into your truck bed. Once the bed is 100% full, you will get a waypoint marked on your map. Go over to the waypoint and follow the on-screen instructions to dump your bed and get paid.

In order to take the role of the excavator, you need to spawn an excavator at the spawner next to the Specialized Job Center ( ). When seated in your excavator, you will be given a location inside the quarry to go and dig at. Once arrived at the dig site, you will need to control the excavator and follow the on-screen instructions to dig up gravel and dump it into the tipper trucks.

(The controls for the boom follow the same control scheme as the submarine controls so if you wish to change the keybindings, change the keys for submarines.).

Rewards

The rewards are distributed to everyone who contributed to that particular drop off (Excavator Operator and Dumptruck Driver) Each Excavator Operator will receive full XP gains no matter how many excavators helped load the trucks, however, the cash reward is split between all excavators that participated. This job can be done solo as well. You can use the excavator to dig up buckets of gravel and filled your own spawned mule truck until full, head to the drop-off point, and reap your rewards!

You get 2 different EXP gains when completing a drop-off.

  • Mining
  • Trucking

As well as cash rewards for your efforts.

Leaderboards

The API supports 4 different leaderboards regarding the job. Those leaderboards can also be found scattered across the Quarry area. All Quarry worker leaderboards are persistent, so they represent the total effort a player has done.

Best Excavator Operators

  • Displayed in "buckets", you gain one point for each excavator action you do. If you fill one common tipper on your own, this will earn you 10 points ( 10 actions )
  • located ingame next to the excavator spawner

Most Cooperative Quarry Workers

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for being part of a delivery that more than one person contributed to.
  • Located ingame following the path starting at the "Davis Quartz" business down under the small train tunnel then straight towards those building containers

Best Dump Truck Operators

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for delivering a tipper load yourself.
  • Located ingame on top of the largest rubble hill, also right below the highest conveyer belt

Quarry Solo

  • Displayed in "deliveries" , you gain one point for filling a tipper without the help of other excavators and also delivering that said tipper on your own
  • Not yet ingame, can only be found in the API

Note that "deliveries" made by the ChernoTipper [Lv.70] will still only grant you one point!

See Also

Miner, another job partially taking place in the Davis Quartz Quarry.

pages.h:
Rockwell Transport Solutions
R.T.S.
The company has closed the job is now public for all players

R.T.S. (also known as Rockwell Transport Solutions) is a former company, with its jobs now available to everyone. You are responsible to either deliver ground vehicles or take to the skies and deliver helicopters and planes . Successful perfect deliveries of regular ground vehicles will award you with that vehicles' one-time-use spawncard.

Getting Started

To start any aspect of R.T.S. , you need to visit the headquarters and change your job at the job marker.

This is located at the Arcadius Business Center. The job marker is located left of the entrance (exterior). You can choose between R.T.S. Aviator, R.T.S. Professional and R.T.S. Transporter.

R.T.S. Transporter

As an R.T.S. Transporter, you can deliver regular vehicles as well as heavier vehicles . Regular vehicles will be faster and will also award you with a one-time-use spawncard upon successful delivery while heavier vehicles awards are doubled per individual delivery due to more time spend. Both options will award you with some cash as well as Racing and Business Experience. The more you complete deliveries in a session, the higher the rewards.

Go to a Vehicle Pickup or Heavy Pickup icon, they can be found all over the map.
A menu will show up, giving you a selection of 2 to 25 vehicles (see #Delivery Milestones). If you chose for heavy you will not be given a selection. Once you have chosen the vehicle you wish to deliver, a destination will be marked on your map. Drive to the destination however you wish, but make sure to not damage the vehicle too much. You will not be able to repair the vehicle and risk losing the spawn card reward.

R.T.S. Aviator

Failure to properly use ATC can get you punished, so make sure you understand how it works!

As an R.T.S. Aviator, you will be delivering small to medium-sized planes and helicopters. Go to an Aviator Pickup icon. A destination will be marked on your map. Fly to the destination, making sure you correctly use ATC. Upon delivery you will be awarded with small amounts of Business, Airline Pilot and Racing Experience.

R.T.S. Professional

As an R.T.S. Professional, you will be able to do both Transporter and Aviator job deliveries.

Delivery Milestones

Reaching certain total delivery milestones will allow you to choose from more vehicles at a time. This begins at a selection of 2 and goes up to 25 at 2000 deliveries. Your total R.T.S. deliveries can be viewed with the in-game /stats command. Alternatively you can also view this in Discord by visiting the #bot-commands channel and typing @Tycoon Stats Bot stats .

(Encrypted) SD cards are mainly used to unlock better or alternative routes and recipes for the Trucking job.
(Encrypted) SD cards were added in the November 10th, 2021 update.

Ways To Obtain SD Cards

  1. Prospecting - To prospect, simply go in game and find a white circle on the map, and press E to start prospecting. (Make sure you own a prospecting scanner.)
  2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting a SD Card. Daily Chests are obtainable automatically when you log in to the server every day.
  3. Marketplace - This is the easiest way to obtain encrypted SD Cards & decrypted SD Card Recipes.
    • SD cards can not be traded (i.e. can not be given to people), but are obtainable through the Marketplace.

How do SD Cards work

  1. When you got an Encrypted SD Card, you need to keep them in your Inventory.
  2. Then go to the FIB Building.
    • In the entrance area you will see a green Marker next to the desk where you can decrypt SD-Cards (Start Scan), see what Secrets you have unlocked already (View learned Secrets) and check your current scan (Check Scan).
  3. Choose "Start Scan" and choose the decrypting method.
    • You can choose between the following options:
      • Slow Scan (48h) = FREE
      • Regular Scan (12h) = $200,000,000
      • Fast Scan (4h) = $1,000,000,000
      • Instant scan (one time) = $1,000,000,000
  4. After the scanning time, you should have the Decrypted SD Card in your Inventory.
    • IF NOT: Go to the FIB Building again and choose "Check Scan"
  5. If you want to learn the secret recipe of the SD Card you got, choose it in your Inventory and hit "Unlock secret".
    • You have learned the secret recipe now and the SD Card will disappear.

SD-Cards

SD Cards were added in the November 10th update in 2021. SD Cards are mainly used to unlock new routes for the Trucking job.

Ways To Obtain SD Cards

1. Prospecting (Prospecting) - To prospect simply go in game and find a white circle on the map, and press E to start prospecting. (Make sure you own a prospecting scanner.)

2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting a SD Card. (To get your daily chests you simply login everyday)

3. Player To Player (Marketplace) - This is the easiest way to obtain encrypted SD Cards & decrypted SD Card Recipes. (Can only be done via marketplace as SD Cards are untradeable! )

How do SD Cards work

1. When you got a Encrypted SD Card you need to keep them in your Inventory.

2. Then go to the FIB Building. In the entrance area you will see a green Marker next to the Desk where you can decrypt SD-Cards (Start Scan), see what Secrets you have unlocked already (View learned Secrets) and check your current scan (Check Scan).

3. Choose "Start Scan" and choose the decrypting method. You can choose between the following options:

  • Instant Scan (0h) = $1,000,000,000 (ONE TIME USE)
  • Slow Scan (48h) = FREE
  • Regular Scan (12h) = $200,000,000
  • Fast Scan (4h) = $1,000,0000,000

4. After the scanning Time you should have the Decrypted SD Card in your Inventory. IF NOT: Go to the FIB Building again and choose "Check Scan"

5. If you want to learn the secret recipe of the SD Card you got choose it in your Inventory and hit "Unlock secret". You have learned the secret recipe now and the SD Card will disappear.

DEACTIVATED 2020 Snowplow

  1. To start the Snowplow job you need to visit your local job center and pick the "Snowplow" job.
  2. Then go to the nearest Car Dealer and buy a snowplow vehicle.

Self Storages are locations on the map where players can deposit and withdraw items. Self Storages are crucial for higher-end trucking.

Trainyard Self Storages have linked storage, meaning that you can deposit items at one Trainyard and retrieve it from another.


Free Self Storages (except for company storages) and Trainyard Self Storages will have a set deposit fee based on items weight ranging from $6.25 per kg to $31.25 (example: depositing 500 sand at $6.25 fee self-storage, you would have to pay $15,625).

The self-storage fee can be completely voided by having Storage Cards. They let you store a set of items for free. (taking our example scenario, depositing 500 sand would now be completely free, as the cards allow to waiver up to $25,000 each. However, this means that depositing will consume more than one card if you go above that value.)

Storage Cards

Storage cards can be obtained by:

  • Looting Treasure Chest [Medium Grade] (6.66%) .
  • Chocolate Egg (2.85%).
  • Opening Treasure Chest [Daily] (4.54%).
  • Successfully paying off loans through earning money from jobs. Amount of storage cards you receive from paying off loans is based on how much your loan is, The higher the loan, the more cards you receive when it's paid off. The rate of cards to be received is the same for all credits and increases along with the price. One card is received for every $62,500 in credit. More info.
Paying down a loan in full directly via the Pacific Standard Bank will not reward you with Storage Cards, only loans that are paid off automatically through receiving money from jobs will reward you with Storage Cards.

Self Storage Transfer License

A Self Storage Transfer License allows you to transfer items from your Self Storage to any other online user that also owns that storage. If there is a fee for placing items in this storage you will also pay a fee for transferring items. The License lasts for 7 days and costs $5,000,000 (5M).
It can be bought at the Market(Premium/VIP).

pages.h:
Server Repair is a specialized job in which you need to repair different servers inside the facility with the use of server cable, component & controls to get your strength, mechanic & player exp as well as your money.

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker   at the N.O.O.S.E. HQ just North of East Los Santos.

2. Go to the yellow marker at the front doors and enter the Server Facility.

3. Once inside go to the orange job selector circle and select Server Repair.

4. Go to the green circle beside the job selector and buy your server repair supplies. You need these to complete repair jobs and if you plan on doing this job for a while you should purchase a lot. You can also come back to this location and purchase more if you run out.

5. Wait for a call out to appear in the top right area of your screen. The callout details the supplies you will need, as seen in the image below.

6. Go to the location marked on your map as Job (Server Repair) and repair the server. All the server repairs are inside this interior.

7. You will keep receiving callouts until you switch jobs.

To get rid of the callout after already switching the job, simply do M > Stop job.

Note: This is not a roleplay server. You can not force anyone to roleplay, but if you have consenting RP’ers, you are allowed to within your party so long as it does not interfere with other players.
Rules List
Number A. - GENERAL RULES
1 Do NOT ram into or kill other players or their vehicles. Vehicle Deathmatching (VDM) is strictly prohibited.
2 Do NOT steal other players' vehicles.
3 Do NOT harass other players or in general interfere with their gameplay. This includes stalking/following or repeatedly buzzing them with an aircraft if they ask you to stop.
4 Do NOT cheat or abuse bugs. This includes client side modifications[*1], exploiting small loopholes, mod menus, gameplay macros, or any other method to progress faster than normal.
5 Do NOT use any racial, homophobic, or any otherwise hateful language and slurs. (Applies to Text Chat and Ingame Voice Chat - Failure to follow this rule will result in severe actions against those who are hateful.)
6 Do NOT use words, similarly spelt words, terms or phrases that could be considered as derogatory or offensive. (Applies to Text Chat and Ingame Voice Chat - Failure to follow this rule may result in severe actions against the player.)
7 Do NOT use coloured text for names.
8 Do Not Buy or Sell in-game items/currency with real world currency, doing so will result in BOTH the Seller AND Buyer being BANNED from our server forever. It breaks FiveM TOS.
9 Always respect other players and staff members.
10 Always report rule breakers to staff either with the report function or in Discord. Not promptly reporting rule breakers you discover could result in punishment for assisting or participating.
11 Always follow and comply with a staff member’s instructions if they ask you to do something or refrain from doing something.
12 Always be aware and respectful of the space around you to avoid collisions or interfering with other players gameplay.
13 Always report any bug(s) you find by pressing M, navigating to Staff Panel and selecting “Report a Bug”.
14 Always refer to the F7 guide before asking for help. This guide is extremely helpful and is made for your convenience!
B. - CHAT RULES
1 Do NOT spam chats.
2 Do NOT argue in chat. If you are having anything more than a civil disagreement with another user, take it to direct messages.
3 Do NOT use overly sexual and inappropriate language or have conversations of sexually charged nature in chat. Always keep jokes respectful and respect other players boundaries regarding what makes them comfortable.
4 Always speak English in chat. Speaking in other languages will get you warned or possibly kicked from the server.
Additionally, in-game advertisements must be in English, or they will be overridden.
5 For Company or Faction chat, the language rule doesn't apply. So any language rules set by respective group can be followed in these specific chats.
C. - FLYING RULES
1 Do NOT spawn or taxi any non-VTOL planes outside the airport.
2 Do NOT takeoff or land an aircraft outside of airports. This includes roads, buildings, and purposely crashing or despawning your plane mid-air to get somewhere faster. You may land helicopters and VTOL anywhere you like as long as it does not block other players; Likewise, you may land seaplanes on water.
3 Do NOT fly HEAVY or aircraft over airline pilot level 30 or cargo pilot level 5 between any buildings. Lower level and leisure aircraft may fly between buildings at the pilots risk, any collision or crash will be at the fault of the pilot and considered ATC failure. This rule does not apply to helicopters.
Lastly and most importantly,
Always have fun, I am sure you will enjoy our server! (Not having fun can be a bannable offense!)
If you see another player not following these server rules you can report them by pressing M then navigating to the “Staff Panel” and pressing “Report a Player”. Please select the player you wish to report and tell us what rule they are breaking.
*1 - Client Side Modifications
  • Anything that changes the shape/size/form of any object/ped/vehicle, is not allowed.
  • Floating objects/structures, changing of the vehicle handling, map modifications are not allowed as it can boost your progress over other players. (exploiting)
  • Everything visual, what only changes the aesthetics of the building/ped/vehicle/object, is allowed.
  • Graphical mods are fine as long as they don't make any of the objects around the map invisible.

(Most of the popular graphics mods add various small objects, usually to vegetation or to the buildings to improve the overall graphical experience, this type of mod is allowed.)

FiveM ToS: https://runtime.fivem.net/platform-license-agreement-12-sept-2023.pdf

As a Street Racer , you can compete against other players' times on race courses.
Head to any Job Center (except for Life Invader) and choose the Street Racer job.

As a racer, you are in a separate 'racing' instance. You will no longer see AI cars and non-racers. To get out of this instance, switch to any other job.

Gaining Experience

Strength is a fundamental skill that allows you to carry more items at a given time. Specific jobs rely heavily on your Strength level. Per level, you unlock an extra 10KG of weight. It is currently the only skill that is capped at level 30, meaning your max base inventory capacity is 300KG. This expands to 345KG with Premium, and can be doubled with the Strength Perk. Using Trailers and Trunks you can go far beyond this limit. Trailers are essential for Trucking routes.

Earning Strength Experience

Knowing what activities give Strength EXP and/or Strength EXP Tokens could prove to be useful. Look below for a list:

Job or Activity Direct Strength EXP Strength EXP Tokens [1] Notes
Trucking ✅ ❌
Cargo Pilot ✅ ❌
Courier ✅ ❌
Transformer Repair ✅ ❌
Server Repair ✅ ❌
IAA Delivery ✅ ❌
Miner ✅ ❌ Only mining in Mineshaft and regular mining in Quarry.
Quarry Worker does not give Strength.
Prospecting ✅ ❌
  1. All jobs that give direct Strength Experience can instead give Strength EXP tokens with the Cargo Perk.

Regular Jobs

Cargo-related jobs (such as Trucking and Cargo Pilot) rely on you having a big inventory capacity. Certain jobs and activities in Transport Tycoon will earn you Strength experience to be able to carry more items.

Trucking

Trucking is the first job most players come in contact with that also gives Strength experience.
Erasers's small weight combined with its decent XP per item makes it one of the fastest method of obtaining Strength experience, compared to other Trucking Cargo.

Cargo Pilot

The Cargo Pilot Jobs not only relies on Strength but also gives it to you.
Transport Air Cargo around the Map from Airport to Airport to gain Strength, Player and Cargo Pilot for Finishing your Route.

Specialized Jobs

Besides trucking, most Specialized Jobs will also reward the player with Strength experience.

Courier

In the Courier Job you deliver packages to houses, warehouses, and stores.
Upon delivering you earn Strength, Player & Trucking experience. Finish the route for a bonus.

Transformer Repair

When repairing transformers you will earn Strength, Player & Mechanic experience.

Server Repair

As with the Transformer job, repairing servers will result in Strength, Player & Mechanic experience.

IAA Delivery

Delivering Coffee and Documents to IAA employees will give Strength & Player experience.

Mining

Mining at the quarry or mineshaft will give Strength & Mining experience.

Activities

Prospecting

Search around the Prospecting Field to find valuable Goods and earn yourself some money.
Along with Money and Goods, you also increase your Strength and Mining Levels.

Milestones

Unlock Strength Level requirement
You can now start the Paramedic job 5

Trivia

Garbage Collector used to also give direct Strength Experience in the Legacy server.

- Make sure to equip the "Trucker (Commercial)" Job. You have to be Trucker LVL 45 in order to start the "Ice Cream Tote Delivery" mission.
- Follow the next steps.

Picking up Ice Cream

Head to the Paleto Bay Shipyard and grab a truck.

Pickup location on the map:

Pickup marker location:

Delivering Ice Cream

Once you've picked up the truck, it'll set a waypoint for you to the drop-off location, drive there.

Drop-Off location on the map:

Drop-Off marker location:

Reverse and park on the spot to deliver your Ice Cream (complete the QTE for a bonus).

Selling your Ice Cream

In order to do that, you'll have to get yourself an Ice Cream truck (Mr Tasty / Mr Tastier)

You'll have to head to one of the following locations (other locations exist but eh who cares right ?)
Near the City Hall:

Near Weazel News HQ:

Each Ice Cream sold will count towards unlocking event titles, you will also obtain yourself some Summer Chests, these contains some interesting stuff !

Transport Tycoon has a web store, where benefits can be bought in exchange for real life currency.

It can be accessed by typing /shop in-game, or by navigating to the Transport Tycoon web store.

Listed below are all options available on the web store. Refer to the web store for up-to-date information.

In-Game

Bonuses

Double EXP Ticket

This bonus is only available on your current server. Once the party starts, it will remain active on that server. In the event of another Double EXP Party being active, yours will be queued up and is started once the previous Party or Parties has finished.

The Double EXP Ticket allows you to start a Double Experience Party on your server that will last for 30 minutes!

Everyone gains 100% more base experience while the party is active.

Treasure Master Key

A reusable item that allows you to open an indefinite amount of Treasure Chests. It can not be traded or trashed.

Mechanic Toolbox

A consumable item which grants additional Mechanic EXP by 50% for 1 hour.

Extra Business Stack

Permanently increases your businesses' maximum collection limit by 1. (16 by default)

By default, your businesses will collect revenue for up to 48 hours (2 days / 16 cycles).

TL;DR: Allows your businesses to collect revenue for another 3 hours (per purchase). Each cycle is 3 hours, meaning 8 cycles will occur every real day.

Extra Business Day

Permanently increases your businesses' maximum collection limit by 8. (16 by default)

By default, your businesses will collect revenue for up to 48 hours (2 days / 16 cycles).

Each cycle is 3 hours, meaning 8 cycles will occur every real day.

TL;DR: Allows your businesses to collect revenue for another 24 hours (per purchase)

Customizations

Re-name Faction

You need to be the Faction President of the Faction you are currently in!

Normal rules for Faction name and tag applies. We will not provide refunds.

Custom License Plate

Customize the license plate on your vehicle!

Restrictions:

  • Must be 8 symbols
  • Space, Letters and numbers only

Upgrades

Speed Trap EMP

Nearby Speed Traps are disabled, meaning you will never be caught again.

Pre-paid Autopass

Using a pre-paid autopass means you will pass any Toll Plaza for free, regardless of what car you are driving.

Instant Respawn

Dying in water will always put you back on land.

You no longer need Pills to re-spawn where you died. The fade-out effect when re-spawning will no longer occur.

This perk replaces the existing "No hunger / thirst" perk

Old description: Completely disable the need to eat and drink!

Fuel System

Quality of life changes to the fuel system.

You can upgrade to Disable Fuel System at a discounted rate if you already own Free Fuel

Free Fuel

No longer pay for fuel, you can refuel for free!

Disable fuel system

Disable the need to maintain fuel in your vehicle.

Other

Captain's Hour

Items in this category help fund and support the Captain's Hour show in Discord.

The show is held by TheCaptain in our Discord at 10PM EST when possible.

Any purchase made from this category will be announced in the Captain's Hour text channel.

Captain's Hour Title

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this in-game chat title!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Captain's Hour Chat Prefix Icon

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this in-game chat prefix icon!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Captain's Hour Playerlist Title

Show your love for Captain's Hour with this player list title!

Your purchase is shown in the Captain's Hour discord channel!

Access

Beta Server access

Allows access to the Beta servers.

Beta servers receive early updates.

You need to join a server to receive this reward.

Gift Cards

Pay-what-you-want

You decide how much to pay. A direct payment option, there are no perks or rewards given by this package.

You may specify a custom amount to pay, and a note for what the purchase is for.

This option can be used for non-standard payment.

Gift Card

A Gift Card you can share with a friend, it can be used during checkout in the web store.

The Gift Card code will be sent to your email after checkout.

Premium & Subscriptions

Purchases with timed benefits.

Self Storage Transfer License (Monthly Subscription)

Allows you to directly transfer items from your own self storage to another players self storage.

A fee is applied as if the items were put in by normal means. (Unless you have Storage Cards)
The items are transfered to the same self storage location, but in the other player's storage inventory.

[LITE] Transportation

These bonuses are for the [LITE] Transportation server

You can join the server via the FiveM server browser or https://cfx.re/join/dgpvx3

purchases may take a moment to go through, you'll need to reconnect to load the purchases.

VIP [LITE]

Gives you the following rewards:

  • Unlock all delivery perks (you can see special deliveries on the map) immediately
  • VIP chat title
  • VIP title under your name for other players

Applies to [LITE] Transportation only!

2x cash [LITE]

All jobs on LITE Transportation will pay you twice the amount of money!

Applies to [LITE] Transportation only!

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions repeatedly asked by the community, compiled for an easier time!

Are Business Stacks / Days permanent or one-time?

Business Stacks permanently increases your business' collection limit by 1 each. Meaning your businesses will collect revenue for an extra 3 hours before they must be collected. (Defaults to 16 stacks, or 48 hours)

Business Days do the exact same, but adds 8 each instead of just one.

When does the Double EXP Party start?

Double EXP Parties start instantly when the Double EXP Ticket is used in-game. It can be started at any time.

If you have any questions regarding the purchases, you can ask in our Discord

pages.h:
Welcome to the technical FAQ

this FAQ answers your simple technical questions and tries to resolve issues as fast as possible.

For more generally Frequently Asked Questions, visit FAQ

Missing Icons/Blips

That "error" can happen through a loading error or just a setting. Otherwise it could also be that you just didn't Discovered that Blip yet as we got a Discovery Script which only show the Blip when you were there at least once.

If you don't see any Blips at all then it's an error and you can resolve it with a simple Reconnect. if the reconnect didn't resolve the issue, then please move to the Clear Cache section and try to clear your cache.

If you just see a Couple Blips like Garages, Fuel Points and unbought Businesses

Then open your M Menu, go into Player Options and then into Interface options. Search the Toggle Map Blips Option and press it Two times

If you just see a Couple Blips , Fuel Points, Traffic Permit markets and Pills

Then open your M Menu, go into Player Options and then into Interface options. Search the Toggle Map Blips Option and press it One time

In the end the Map should look like this:

Map is glitching out

Transport Tycoon displays a lot more blips than was originally intended for Grand Theft Auto V. This causes the map to malfunction at times.

Wrong blip is being selected/Can not select blips/Can not move the map

To temporarily fix this issue, switch to a different menu tab with Q or E, let that new tab load in and then go back to the Map. You should now be able to interact with the map correctly again.

Waypoint is being placed somewhere else

See temporary fix above. Alternatively you can place a Point Of Interest (TAB by default). You can then place your waypoint on the POI. POI's do not save between sessions.

Map Legend is flickering

This is due to hitting a hard limit of blip types. To fix this issue you will need to hide some blips. To do this, type /blip, select Hidden Blips and hide blips you do not use.

Clear Cache

So you want to know how to clear your cache as you encounter a crash on the server and/or cant join anymore? 

1. Press WIN+R
2. Type in "%localappdata%\FiveM\FiveM.app" or "%localappdata%\FiveM" dependant on when you installed FiveM
3. You are now in your Application Folder where you want to delete the file "cache.xml"
4. Now as you deleted that file try to join one of the servers
5. If that didn't help then go back to Step 1 and continue after that with step 6.
6. So the 3rd step didn't work then now as you are again in the Application folder go also into the Cache folder.
7. After the re-verification try to join the server again.
8. If that also didn't work go back into the cache folder and also delete the server's folder.
8.1 This will delete all server files you have downloaded and need to re-download them when you join the Server.
9. When Step 8, 8.1 don't work you want to delete the Game folder (this will re-verify the game files)

Steam authentication failed: Http 429

Note: This method will only work if you have other active identifiers linked to your account.

To fix this you need to close steam: Go to the top left of the screen Steam > Exit or use task manager to close the steam bootstrapper. Once steam has fully closed. Launch FiveM and join the server. After you have loaded into the server you are free to open steam again.

yaml-cpp: error at line x, column xx: illegal EOF in scalar

That error is an common FiveM error the only fix from our side would be to just retry to join the server. It could take up to 40 retries.

Otherwise, you could also just press enter and it should connect right away

Failed to GetInfo server after 3 attempts

This is a common FiveM error. Try connecting through http://connect.tycoon.community, http://ttstats.eu, or press F8 and type: connect 2epova (main server) or connect njyvop (beta server) .

Airports are not loading in

This is a common issue with FiveM Streaming Maps that we use for the Airports. To fix this please go to Esc -> Settings -> Advanced Graphics -> High Detail Streaming While Flying> On

This will fix the issues of airports not loading in whilst flying!

Falling through the ground? World textures start to disappear? Buildings looking like mush?

Try highering the Extended Texture Budget bit by bit until the issue stops.
Do not max out this setting all at once as this can worsen the situation and can cause other issues: 

Esc -> Settings -> Graphics -> Extended Texture Budget

Set your texture quality to normal: 

Esc -> Settings -> Graphics -> Texture Quality -> Normal

On this page you can read all about EXP Tokens and their uses. They were previously known as Vouchers.

EXP Token

When doing certain jobs, you earn EXP Tokens. Each EXP Token is worth 0.1 experience in its skill. (see below)

The EXP Token cannot be traded with other players. To do this, you need to convert it to Bonus EXP first.

Each EXP Token can be converted to a Bonus EXP item. In order to convert all at once, you can press the left arrow when the convert option is highlighted.

Bonus EXP

When the "Bonus EXP" item is in your inventory, you will gain additional experience every time you normally gain experience. Each Bonus EXP item is equivalent to 0.1 experience. For every 0.1 experience you gain, a Bonus EXP item is consumed and you gain an additional 0.1 experience. This effect goes up to 100.0 experience at a time. (Meaning up to 1000 Bonus EXP items can be consumed at once)

The Bonus EXP item can be put on the marketplace, allowing you to effectively sell the EXP Tokens you receive.

Cargo Pilot Perk

With the Cargo Pilot Perk, you can obtain large amounts of Bonus EXP quickly. With the Perk active, you will no longer receive any EXP, and 50% of that sacrificed EXP is turned into EXP Bonus instead. This is useful for players looking to earn money by selling Bonus EXP via player to player trading, or by selling through the Marketplace.

Removal of Vouchers

Bonus EXP and EXP Tokens were previously known as Skill Vouchers.
Vouchers discouraged players from doing jobs, allowing them to complete many jobs by simply paying their way out of it. Never once setting foot in a job vehicle.

  • EXP Tokens still keep the benefit of "paying for experience".
  • EXP Tokens keeps trading healthy (with the Bonus EXP item).
  • Players now have the ability to get boosted EXP yields without having to sit idle for hours at the Grand Exchange.
  • You still maintain the player trade profit aspect from the Vouchers.

Converting old Vouchers

If you've ended up with Skill Vouchers in your inventory and don't know what to do with them, they can be converted to the new system. Simply put them into any kind of external storage (for example a vehicle trunk or self storage) and then take them back out.

If your Computer can handle it, consider disabling Vsync. Your train will accelerate and stop faster with higher FPS.

Train Conductors transport passengers around the map by rail. There are two different metro lines, one passenger train line and one freight train line available. As a level 1 Conductor, you will start with Metro and are then able to unlock Freight and Passenger Trains later on.

Metro / Subway Tram

  • Head to any Job Center (except for LifeInvader) and select the Train Conductor job. The smallest tier Metro requires level 1 conductor, which is what you start with.
  • Find one of the red metro train icons on the map, located at LSIA or Davis street, then find the marker and press the indicated button to open the metro spawn menu.
  • Select a Metro train tier you can use.
  • Drive forward until the job prompt begins.
  • Drive your metro to all the stops indicated on your map to complete the route.
  • You will earn Train Conductor Experience and Experience Tokens from each stop and for completing your route.
    • If your Train Conductor level is 100 or higher, you will instead receive extra Experience Tokens but no more regular Experience from Metro.

Freight Train Conductor

  • Go to the Job Selector and select the Conductor job.
  • Drive to the red train shelter icon located on the eastern side of Los Santos.
  • Find the floating orange marker and press the indicated button to open the Freight train spawn menu
  • Spawn your desired train size depending on your conductor level.
  • Drive your train to the starting point and complete the freight train route.
  • You will earn money, Experience and EXP Tokens from each stop and a bonus for completing a route.

Passenger Train Conductor

  • Go to any Job Selector (except for LifeInvader) and select the Conductor job.
  • Drive to the train station near the Elysian Island docks, or the Paleto Bay train station just North of the Sawmill.
  • These train stations are marked by a red train icon on your map.
  • Find the floating orange marker on the terminal and press the indicated button to open the passenger train spawn menu.
  • Select your desired train based on your conductor level.
  • Drive your train forward to the terminal and begin your route.
  • Follow the tracks and stop at the designated stations .
  • The route ends at Paleto Bay, where you can start the Southbound route that goes back to Los Santos again.
  • You will earn money, Experience and EXP Tokens from each stop and a bonus for completing a route.
In the city of Los Santos all passenger trains are slowed down automatically. As soon as you leave the city this restriction will be removed. It auto engages when you enter the city again.

pages.h:
Transformer Repair is a specialized job in which you need to repair broken Transformers with the use of different Fuses, Relays & Cables to receive mechanic, strength and player experience as well as money.

Getting Started

1. Go to the Specialized Job marker   in the Northeast area of Los Santos.

2. Go to the orange Job Selector circle and choose Transformer Repair.

3. Go to the green market icon and purchase Cables, Fuses, and Relays. You need these to complete repair jobs and if you plan on doing this job for a while you should purchase a lot. You can also come back to this location and purchase more when you run out.

4. Wait for a call out to appear in the top right area of your screen, the call out details the supplies you will need, as seen in this image below.

5. Go to the location marked on your map as Job (Transformer Repair) and repair the transformer.

  • You will keep receiving callouts until you switch jobs.
  • The Sparrow helicopter can be used for this job. It has a capacity of 1,000 KG ( 1,150 with Tycoon Premium).
To get rid of the callout after already switching to another job, simply press M > Stop job.

Data

This data is likely to not be very reliable currently due to the small sample size and the very deviating amounts requested
(see minimum and maximum in table below).

Based on a sample of 43 callouts, the average (rounded up) required materials of fuse, cable and relay were 14,28 and 9 respectively.

  • From the same sample:
statistic fuse cable relay
minimum 8 15 5
maximum 21 41 11
median 13 28 8
modus 12 28 7

Based on the average values above: if a player were to use the Sparrow, while having an active Tycoon Premium license, with 30 strength, the player can fit 378 fuse, 756 cable, and 243 relay in the inventory, and can dump 3 times to the trunk for another 1.134, 2.268 and 729 respectively. All these amounts combined would be enough for about 108 callouts. If using the maximum values instead (worst case scenario), this would only be enough for 72 callouts.

Treasure Chests are chests that spawn individually whenever someone levels up in a skill. They can also randomly spawn in bulk. The chests can easily be found because of their icon on the map and their high-rising yellow beam.

Ways to obtain Treasure Chests

While Treasure Chests are obtained simply by passing through the high-rising yellow beam, there are other ways to obtain them too and are listed below:

  • Beach Cleaning will give you Trash as a sub-product which can be saved up to create low/medium/high and ultra-grade Treasure chests at the Recycling Plant up North in Sandy Shores.
  • Low and Medium-grade Chests can also be obtained by donating to the Fountain of Wealth. $50k for low-grade chest & $250k for medium-grade chest.
  • Exclusively, Ultra-grade Treasure Chest can be purchased from the Market(Premium/VIP) for 10 Skill Level Tokens.
  • Can also be purchased from the Marketplace or traded with other players.

Treasure Key

To open a treasure chest, one will need a Treasure Key, which is consumed when you open the chest. These keys can be found from the same high-rising yellow beams or:

  • Received via breaking down a medium, high or ultra grade chest.
  • Prospecting (Legendary 0.09%) (Rare 0.5%).
  • Open Treasure Chest [Low-grade] (5.55%).
  • Buying it from a player or Marketplace.


If you have a treasure key and a treasure chest, go to M → Inventory → Your chest → Open to open the treasure chest.

After interacting with the chest, it will grant an item (see treasure contents below) and will subsequently apply a cooldown of a few seconds to prevent people from farming chests too rapidly.

Daily Chests

A Treasure Chest [Daily] can be obtained automatically when you log in to the server every day.

  • There's also a 4.54% chance a Treasure Chest [Daily] contains another Daily Chest when opened.

Rewards

  • High grade treasure
  • Medium grade treasure
  • Low grade treasure
  • Treasure keys

All items can be sold on the Marketplace

Truckers are the backbone of Transport Tycoon. We’ve developed a complex web of cargo materials that allow you to simply sell one at a time, or collect and combine cargoes in multi-point routes for maximum profit!

Be sure to ask around for helpful guides developed by the community. Oh, and we also have a custom radio station! We offer TruckersFM,Simulator Radio and UpBeat Radio available in the left-bottom-center area of the radio wheel.

Getting started

If this is your first time trucking, it's recommended to read the Getting Started Guide for essential basic information about usage of the vehicle trunk/storage and trucking in general.
  • Head to the Job Center and select the Trucker job.
  • Visit the Car Dealership to purchase the Speedo Express or a combination of a semi-cab (truck) and trailer.
    • The Speedo Express is free and has a trunk capacity equal to your own inventory capacity from 30kg to 300kg.

Vehicles

Trucking requires a semi-cab (truck) and trailer to store cargo in. Semi-cabs can be bought from a car dealership or alternatively can be spawned at a few locations around the map. Examples include LSIA, Sandy Shores, and LS Docks. Players that are short on cash can begin with the free Speedo Express. The trunk capacity of the Speedo scales with the players' Strength level.

Basic Commercial Routes

You start a trucking route by picking up cargo from one of the following cargo sellers. Go to the cargo seller to obtain your cargo, load as much as you can in your vehicle and then head to a Cargo Buyer that accepts the cargo to sell it. Logs, Recycled Trash, Toxic Waste, Recycled Electronics and Quarry Rubble are all part of more in-depth commercial trucking routes. Make sure to have a look at the Advanced Cargo Routes section.

1. Erasers and Tools can only be placed in the Speedo Express or Mk1, Mk2, Mk3, or Mk4 Trailers. All other trailers will show an error when adding to trunk
2. The trucking level required indicates the level at which the map blip is unlocked. You can actually take any of these items to your trunk at any trucking/strength level.

Logging

Logging is unlocked at level 6, this is the first type of trucking where there are multiple steps in the process. You want to:

  • Pick up Logs from the Logging Camp.
  • Take the Logs to the Sawmill to turn them into Sawdust or Planks.
    • Both the Sawdust and the Planks can be sold at the LS Port Export or stored in Self Storages to be combined with other items.

Recycled Materials Base Process

At level 9 you will unlock Recycled Trash, this can be picked up from the Recycling Center. You want to:

  • Take the Recycled Trash to the Sorting Facility to obtain three materials from it:
    • Scrap Plastic can be exported from the McKenzie Export.
    • Scrap Aluminum and Scrap Tin can be refined at the LS Foundry.
      • Refined Aluminum and Refined Tin are exported from the LS Port Export.

From here, the process will evolve allowing more materials and new combinations of materials. The more steps the process has, the more you will earn from it. Item descriptions and exploration of the different locations should lead you on to new processes.

Batteries are created from Quarry Rubble of the Quarry, Recycled Trash of the Recycling Center and Toxic Waste of the Elysian Island Waste Deposit.

Premium Trucking Routes

There are Currently 3 Tycoon Premium Trucking Routes.

Concrete

Concrete is created from Quarry Rubble from the Quarry, Logs from a Logging Camp, Unfiltered Water from the Land Act Reservoir and Toxic Waste from the Elysian Island Waste Deposit. It can be sold at the Alta Construction Site.

Rebar

And then there is also the Rebar Route.

House

The House route uses every Advanced Trucking Route and all other Premium Trucking Routes and makes them to one ultimate Route. It requires Tycoon Premium and Lvl 100 Trucking to complete. Houses can be made at the House Construction Site.

Some trucking sub-routes require a trucking sub-job as well. These jobs can be acquired at the Trucking HQ . There are several trucking sub-jobs available:

It is also possible to change sub-job by using a Trucker's PDA. They can be obtained by buying it on the Marketplace, buying from a player and is also a possible reward from a Treasure Chest (Daily).
The master sub-job is obtained at 1,000,000 (1M) trucking experience, and allows you to see all (sub-)trucking transformers at once.

SD-Cards

SD Cards were added in the November 10th update in 2021. SD Cards are mainly used to unlock new routes for the Trucking job.

Ways To Obtain SD Cards

1. Prospecting (Prospecting) - To prospect simply go in game and find a white circle on the map, and press E to start prospecting. (Make sure you own a prospecting scanner.)

2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting a SD Card. (To get your daily chests you simply login everyday)

3. Player To Player (Marketplace) - This is the easiest way to obtain encrypted SD Cards & decrypted SD Card Recipes. (Can only be done via marketplace as SD Cards are untradeable! )

How do SD Cards work

1. When you got a Encrypted SD Card you need to keep them in your Inventory.

2. Then go to the FIB Building. In the entrance area you will see a green Marker next to the Desk where you can decrypt SD-Cards (Start Scan), see what Secrets you have unlocked already (View learned Secrets) and check your current scan (Check Scan).

3. Choose "Start Scan" and choose the decrypting method. You can choose between the following options:

  • Instant Scan (0h) = $1,000,000,000 (ONE TIME USE)
  • Slow Scan (48h) = FREE
  • Regular Scan (12h) = $200,000,000
  • Fast Scan (4h) = $1,000,0000,000

4. After the scanning Time you should have the Decrypted SD Card in your Inventory. IF NOT: Go to the FIB Building again and choose "Check Scan"

5. If you want to learn the secret recipe of the SD Card you got choose it in your Inventory and hit "Unlock secret". You have learned the secret recipe now and the SD Card will disappear.

FAQs

How do I detach my trailer?

You can detach your Trailer by holding the H key. To re-attach your Trailer, press the H key when prompted, your Trailer will snap to the same orientation your Truck is facing.

How Can I customise my MK10-13

  1. Park your Trailer over LS Customs
  2. Detach your Trailer from your Truck
  3. Move your Truck away from LS Customs
  4. Head to the side over your trailer and press F to 'drive' the trailer
  5. Now use the Enter Key to enter LS Customs

How can I customise my MK14?

  1. Park your Trailer over LS Customs
  2. Detach your Trailer from your Truck
  3. Move your Truck away from LS Customs
  4. Go back to your Trailer and open your Trunk (see Getting Started Guide)
  5. The Trailer door will now be open, go into the back of your Trailer and press F to 'drive' the Trailer
  6. Now use the Enter key to enter LS Customs

What is Tycoon Gaming?

As a community, we currently focus mainly on Transport Tycoon on the FiveM platform.

Transport Tycoon puts you into the vast world of San Andreas, where your goal is to build yourself up to the status of multi-millionaire (or even billionaire!). By working hard in several unique jobs you will eventually gain new equipment and unlock new features that will aid you in an even faster way to the top!

Experience the skies of San Andreas & Cayo Perico while you're transporting passengers or cargo via planes. Travel thousands of kilometers on the endless network of roads in your own truck while trying to navigate your logistics route. Or take a break, sit down at the pier, and fish while you watch the sunset on the horizon. Plus several other jobs and activities to experience on the Transport Tycoon servers.

Tycoon Premium is an account license that offers multiple bonuses and perks.

How do I get Tycoon Premium?

Tycoon Premium can be obtained in multiple ways:

  • Purchase it at the City Hall for $50,000,000 (50 Million) or with 100 Skill Level Tokens
  • Rewarded to $25 or $50 Patreon Patrons as a benefit for as long as the membership lasts.

You will receive a Premium Package when you buy it.
To find and use the package go to your inventory (M -> Inventory) and select the Premium Package
Once used, your tycoon premium will immediately activate.

Once the Premium Package has been used, it cannot be traded anymore.

How long does the Premium license last?

Tycoon Premium lasts 30 days from the time of activation. If you activate a new premium license during that time, it will not extend the existing duration, but will start the 30 days over again. For Patreon, Premium will last for as long as the membership lasts.

Tycoon Premium perks

As a Premium member you will receive the following perks:

  • Access to Premium Vehicles.
  • A Global 15% inventory size increase. This includes player inventory, vehicle trunks and storage units.
  • A star next to your name in chat. (Activate in M -> Player Options -> Chat Appearance)
  • A special title and icon in the player list. (Activate in M -> Player Options -> Chat Appearance)
  • Access to Premium Trucking Routes.
  • Access to the "Take to Trunk" and "Dump Trunk" option in storage units.

Troubleshooting

If for some reason you do not receive a Premium Package when purchasing, relog immediately. Upon relogging, you should now properly see the package in your inventory

Trivia

  • Premium used to also give a global 50% Experience increase, this was removed with the fresh start.

pages.h:
Privacy Policy

Welcome to the Tycoon Gaming Wiki. This privacy policy explains our practices regarding data collection, use, and protection for our users.

Data Collection

Account Information: We collect usernames and passwords solely for the purpose of creating and managing user accounts. No email or additional personal identifying information is required. User Contributions: Contributions to the wiki are publicly visible and associated with the user's account.

Use of Information

The information we collect is used exclusively for account management and user authentication. We do not use this information for marketing or any other purposes.

Data Sharing and Disclosure

Personal information is not shared with third parties, except as required by law. User contributions are publicly accessible and may be used by other users.

Cookies and Tracking

The Tycoon Gaming Wiki uses cookies as part of the MediaWiki software. These cookies are essential for website functions such as user session management. We do not have control over these cookies and do not use them for tracking purposes. Users can control cookie settings through their browser settings.

Data Security

We implement industry-standard measures to protect user information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

User Rights

Users have the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of their personal data. For such requests, please contact us using the details provided below.

Data Retention

We store collected data indefinitely, as long as the server hosting the data remains operational. Users can request the deletion of their account and associated data by contacting us.

Changes to This Policy

We reserve the right to update this privacy policy as necessary. Any significant changes will be notified on the Wiki.

Contact Us

For any questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact Glitchdetector. (Discord Name: glitchdetector)

Upgrade Kits Information

Some of the Upgrade kits remain disabled, but others work, Most of the cash Upgrades no longer work apart from the Hauler and Hauler Custom Upgrade.
This article or section is a work-in-progress.
It is not finished and is being worked on.
You can help, by getting in contact with the last person that was editing this page.
Alternatively you can help by adding the missing content yourself! 🤍

Upgrade kits allow you to upgrade or alter a vehicle via certain locations around the map! There are a few ways to obtain upgrade kit chests. All information is below.

Ways to obtain upgrade kits

  1. Prospecting - This is the most common way of receiving an upgrade kit, however, the chance of getting one is low. (Don't expect to get one quickly, may take hours or days depending on your luck.)
  2. Daily Chests - This is another way of getting an upgrade kit, having a much lower chance of receiving it. (Daily Chests are obtained automatically when you log in to the server every day.
  3. Marketplace - This is the easiest way to obtain upgrade kits. (Can only be done via marketplace and not player to player trading as upgrade kits are untradeable! )

There are also multiple locations where vehicles can be upgraded. These locations vary, depending on the type. (e.g sport/super etc) If you are in a vehicle that's able to upgrade, a blip on your in-game map will appear showing you the upgrade station location.

NOT ALL VEHICLES REQUIRE A KIT TO UPGRADE! SOME HAVE DIFFERENT REQUIREMENTS SUCH AS MONEY OR SPACESHIP PARTS!

All Upgradable Vehicles

There are a handful of vehicles that can only be obtained through upgrading another vehicle. Vehicle can require both an upgrade kit and money to upgrade. A vehicle shipment indicates the original vehicle can only be made or obtained from Vehicle Shipments. After upgrading, some vehicles can be upgraded again to an even better vehicle.

Vehicle Shipments

Trucking level 100 and Tycoon Premium are required to do this process.


You can create different Vehicle Shipment Cards.
You can either use these and the vehicle will go to your garage permanently,
or you can sell them on the marketplace.

pages.h:
Vehicles can be bought at a vehicle shop, which then become available for spawning at a garage. Vehicles require fuel to run, and the top speed of a vehicle may be different from vanilla cars. They can be found in Central LS (Simeon's car dealership), Sandy Shores, Paleto Bay, Cayo Perico and possibly at your faction. Owned vehicles can be sold to other players using a Shipping Container.

The availability of vehicles to purchase rotates each day. Once a vehicle becomes available it can be bought from the store for a few days. This means that if you are looking for a specific vehicle and it is not visible in the vehicle shop, you may need to wait a few days for it to become available. Currently company vehicles are not able to be purchased. Purchase cars wisely, because you need to spend around $154,500,000,000 if you want to buy all vehicles.

Rules

Normal Rules:

  1. Do not vandalize.
  2. Do not remove chunks of information unless you need to.
  3. Refrain from revealing hidden and secret content as this ruins the secret element.

Translator Rules:

  1. Only edit protected pages to add translations.
  2. The Rule above does not apply to Transport Tycoon Staff, who are allowed to edit those pages.
  3. You are allowed to add/remove yourself in the Translator Section on the Credits page.

Guidelines

  1. Information should not include personal opinions
    1. Direct information must be provided
    2. Do not include any bias
  2. Use page links as often as possible, it's easier for everyone that way.

How to contribute

The default theme/"skin" hides most editing tools for a clean user-interface. For easier access, switch to the editor theme:

  1. Go to Preferences
  2. Under Appearance, select the Editor skin
  3. Save changes

Translator Tutorial

For all currently available languages, please see this!

Page Creation

In order to translate a page, you have to either go to an existing (e.x not finished) translated page of it, or "create" one:
Simply navigate to https://dash.tycoon.community/wiki/index.php/LANGUAGE_INITIALS:Tycoon_Gaming_Wiki and click "create this page".

Replace `LANGUAGE_INTIALS` with your language's initials. For example, German: DE

Categories

Every language has it's own category of pages that were translated.
Only add [[Category:LANGUAGE_INITIALS]] to the bottom of your translated Page.

Templates

In order to translate templates, simply put a language tag between the template, and the template name
It should look like this: Template:LANGUAGE_INITIALS:Template_name
to use those in pages, it's quite the same:
{{LANGUAGE_INITIALS:Template_Name}}

A list of templates used in a page can be seen at the bottom of it.

General Editing Stuff

Templates

You'll probably see the following abbreviation a lot of times while editing wiki pages: {{}}
The contents inside those brackets make it possible to render a "template"
For example, use {{Car Dealer/Vehicles/Bicycles}} to show all purchasable bicycles.
